outcome: Incidence of congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV) in neonates
cohort: The study included 65 women and 74 neonates born at less than 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: The combined prevalence of maternal CMV seropositivity was 89%, and the combined incidence of neonatal cCMV (detected in urine) was 5.4% among preterm neonates born at less than 34 weeks gestation, with specific rates differing between the US and India.
followup_time: Maternal blood was collected within 5 days after delivery, and neonatal urine was tested at birth.
